subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when native open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: The current bug is source-reproducible, but the PR's union_id source is disputed and the wrong identity contract can either keep suppressing target-bot messages or admit messages to the wrong bot.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Validate a stable Feishu bot identity source, rebuild this fix on current main, and cover every mention admission path before merge.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Feishu Identity Work
options.body: Keep this branch as investigation context while a broader Feishu multi-bot identity design becomes the canonical fix path.

options.title: Close This Branch, Keep The Issue
options.body: If union_id is unavailable for bots, close this PR and keep the linked issue open for a different identity strategy.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Validate a stable Feishu bot identity source, rebuild this fix on current main, and cover every mention admission path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this PR and already requested a current-main rewrite on the affected Feishu identity surface.
